# Khadeeja Designs
> A boutique Aari embroidery studio in Trichy (Tiruchirappalli), Tamil Nadu, creating handcrafted bridal blouse designs and custom embroidery for customers across India.

## Key facts
- Business: Khadeeja Designs
- Location: 17 East Sayakara Lane, Jaffersha Street, Trichy 620008
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 86674 54391
- Email: contact@khadeejadesigns.in
- Hours: 10 am to 7 pm, Monday to Saturday; Sunday by appointment
- Enquiries: response within 6 hours during studio hours
- Ordering: enquire, receive a quote, confirm the design brief and advance, courier your blouse or saree, then receive it back with tracked delivery
- Design range: 7 listed designs from ₹1,999 to ₹8,499; listed prices cover the embroidery work, while the garment, courier and changes beyond the listing are quoted separately
- Services: bridal and custom Aari embroidery for blouses and sarees, with designs tailored to the garment and occasion
- Social: https://instagram.com/khadeeja.designs
